provenance.note: Seed priors. Every entry is to be replaced by `python -m agentsim fit` on real OTel-shaped traces at rung 0. Numbers marked TraceLab are from Zhu et al. 2026 (arXiv 2606.30560, Tables 2/7/8/10, Fig. 8, Sec. 6). AgentServeSim = arXiv 2606.09613 Table 3 (BFCL v4, SWE-bench via mini-SWE-agent). AgentSysBench = arXiv 2608.15127. Entries marked PRIOR are unverified guesses exposed as knobs.
provenance.tool_duration: Shaped to reproduce TraceLab Fig. 8 / Sec. 6.2 (Claude): calls <1 s = 70% of calls and <1% of tool time; calls >1 min = 4.9% of calls and 92% of tool time; mean 16.8 s. Per-kind split is PRIOR; the aggregate is checked by `fidelity` and reported.
